notes:
TCC Website Features 0.9.9: event details and labels in the Divi editor

In the Divi 5 editor one click on an event's title, banner or Location
card edits the shared event template for every event, which is how an
addition meant for one event showed on all of them. New feature
event-editor-preview, editor only (visitors see no change):

- The template's event short codes show the open event's real day,
  time, place, description, rooms and Register button instead of
  "(filled in automatically)". Divi draws them by posting each short
  code to /?et_pb_preview=true with post_id = the event; the feature
  makes that event the current post just for those short codes.
- The event's own Post Content box gets a teal dashed edge and the
  label "This event only: add buttons, pictures or text here".
- While a shared template layer has its settings open, a dark notice
  under the menu says the change will show on every event.

Help tab: new "How to add a button or picture to one event only" card
(including the one-time "Use The Divi Builder" step and the
one-event-per-date note for Planning Center events) and two Events
troubleshooting lines. AI prompts, working notes and CLAUDE.md updated.
launch.json gains a local server that hands the built zip to the
browser pane for uploading to staging.

Installed and checked on staging; not tagged.
